activation.discipline: Continuous information ranks may only resize an already-approved technical tranche after prospective activation; they never create add authority.

policy.tavily_policy: Tavily credits (bucket brief) are spent only on unresolved high-impact events in tavily_resolution_queue, each resolved with its `command` (clawock web-search: DeepSeek and Tavily asked together, results labelled by provider). DeepSeek search has no credit budget and may be used for any event; its rows are evidence to interpret, not confirmation.
